calls.lyrics: 空に咲いた 花火のように
また来年と 約束した

また来年と 約束した
空に咲いた 花火のように

lyrics.ja: ゆれる街灯 篠突く雨
lyrics.en: Shaking streetlights, a pouring rain

lyrics.ja: 傘もささずに 駆け出した
lyrics.en: Without an umbrella, I ran out

lyrics.ja: 水たまりに映る空は
lyrics.en: The sky reflected in a puddle

lyrics.ja: 祭りのあとの 寂しさか
lyrics.romaji: matsuri no ato no sabishisa ka
lyrics.en: Is it the loneliness after the festival?

lyrics.ja: はしゃいだ声が 遠ざかる
lyrics.en: Excited voices fade into the distance

lyrics.ja: 夏の終わりを 告げるように
lyrics.romaji: natsu no owari o tsugeru you ni
lyrics.en: As if announcing the end of summer
lyrics.zh: 彷彿在宣告夏日的終結

lyrics.ja: 空に咲いた 花火のように
lyrics.romaji: sora ni saita hanabi no you ni
lyrics.en: Like fireworks blooming in the sky
lyrics.zh: 如同在空中綻放的煙火

lyrics.ja: 一瞬の夢 追いかけた
lyrics.en: I chased a fleeting dream

lyrics.ja: きらめく星屑 散りばめて
lyrics.en: Scattering sparkling stardust

lyrics.ja: また来年と 約束した
lyrics.en: We promised to meet again next year

lyrics.ja: 風が運んだ 金魚の匂い
lyrics.romaji: kaze ga hakonda kingyo no nioi
lyrics.en: The scent of goldfish carried by the wind

lyrics.ja: 浴衣の裾を 翻し
lyrics.en: Flipping the hem of my yukata

lyrics.ja: はぐれないように 繋いだ手
lyrics.en: Hands held tight, so we wouldn't get lost

lyrics.ja: 熱い鼓動が 響き合う
lyrics.en: Our warm heartbeats resonate with each other
lyrics.zh: 炙熱的心跳聲彼此共鳴

lyrics.ja: 賑やかな声が 遠ざかる
lyrics.en: Lively voices fade into the distance

lyrics.ja: 夏の終わりを 惜しむように
lyrics.romaji: natsu no owari o oshimu you ni
lyrics.en: As if regretting the end of summer
lyrics.zh: 彷彿在惋惜夏日的終結

lyrics.ja: 空に咲いた 花火のように
lyrics.romaji: sora ni saita hanabi no you ni
lyrics.en: Like fireworks blooming in the sky
lyrics.zh: 如同在空中綻放的煙火

lyrics.ja: 一瞬の夢 追いかけた
lyrics.en: I chased a fleeting dream

lyrics.ja: きらめく星屑 散りばめて
lyrics.en: Scattering sparkling stardust

lyrics.ja: また来年と 約束した
lyrics.en: We promised to meet again next year

lyrics.ja: 過ぎ去りし日々は 幻か
lyrics.en: Are the days gone by just an illusion?

lyrics.ja: 胸に残るは 淡い記憶
lyrics.romaji: mune ni nokoru wa awai kioku
lyrics.en: What remains in my heart are faint memories
lyrics.zh: 胸中殘留著淡淡的回憶
